title: Classic Pancakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add wet ingredients. Cook on griddle until golden.

title: Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Whisk eggs with milk. Cook in butter over low heat, stirring gently.

title: French Toast
instructions: Dip bread in egg mixture. Fry until golden on both sides.

title: Oatmeal Bowl
instructions: Cook oats with milk. Top with banana, blueberries, and honey.

title: Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast bread. Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt. Spread on toast.

title: Granola Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Layer yogurt, granola, and strawberries. Drizzle with honey.

title: Egg Benedict
instructions: Poach eggs. Toast muffins. Layer ham, egg, and hollandaise sauce.

title: Banana Smoothie
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.

title: Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Scramble eggs. Fill tortilla with eggs, beans, cheese, and salsa.

title: Waffles
instructions: Mix batter. Cook in waffle iron until crispy.

title: Cheese Omelette
instructions: Beat eggs. Cook in butter, add cheese, fold and serve.

title: Açaí Bowl
instructions: Blend açaí with banana. Top with granola and coconut.

title: Shakshuka
instructions: Simmer tomato sauce with spices. Crack eggs into sauce and cook covered.

title: Croissant
instructions: Make laminated dough. Shape into crescents. Bake until golden.

title: Chia Pudding
instructions: Mix chia seeds with milk and vanilla. Refrigerate overnight. Top with mango.

title: Beshbarmak
instructions: Boil lamb until tender. Roll and cut dough sheets. Cook dough in broth. Serve meat on dough with onion sauce.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Toss lettuce with dressing. Top with croutons, parmesan, and grilled chicken.

title: Chicken Soup
instructions: Simmer chicken with vegetables. Add noodles and cook until tender.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter bread. Add cheese. Grill until golden and cheese melts.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic. Add tomatoes and simmer. Blend smooth. Add cream.

title: Club Sandwich
instructions: Toast bread. Layer turkey, bacon, lettuce, and tomato. Cut diagonally.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: Chop vegetables. Toss with olives and feta. Dress with olive oil.

title: BLT Wrap
instructions: Cook bacon. Layer all ingredients in tortilla and wrap.

title: Minestrone
instructions: Sauté vegetables. Add broth and tomatoes. Simmer. Add pasta and beans.

title: Tuna Salad
instructions: Mix tuna with mayo, celery, and lemon juice. Serve on lettuce.

title: Kuurdak
instructions: Fry beef pieces until browned. Add onion and potato. Cook until potatoes are tender.

title: Chicken Wrap
instructions: Slice chicken. Layer in tortilla with vegetables and ranch.

title: Plov
instructions: Fry onion and meat. Add carrots and spices. Layer rice on top. Steam until done.

title: Mushroom Soup
instructions: Sauté mushrooms and onion. Add broth and simmer. Blend. Add cream.

title: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice mozzarella and tomato. Layer with basil. Drizzle with oil and vinegar.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Brown beef with onion and garlic. Add tomato sauce and simmer. Serve over spaghetti.

title: Grilled Salmon
instructions: Season salmon. Grill for 4-5 minutes per side. Serve with lemon.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Stir-fry chicken. Add vegetables and sauce. Serve over rice.

title: Beef Tacos
instructions: Cook seasoned beef. Fill shells with beef, lettuce, cheese, and salsa.

title: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Spread sauce on dough. Add cheese. Bake at high heat. Top with basil.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Sauté onion. Add curry paste and chicken. Pour in coconut milk. Simmer.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown beef. Sauté mushrooms and onion. Add sour cream. Serve over noodles.

title: Fish and Chips
instructions: Make batter. Fry fish until golden. Fry chips. Serve with tartar sauce.

title: Pad Thai
instructions: Soak noodles. Stir-fry shrimp. Add noodles and sauce. Top with peanuts.

title: Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Cook pasta. Sauté chicken. Make cream sauce with parmesan. Toss together.

title: Lamb Chops
instructions: Season lamb chops. Sear in hot pan. Rest and serve.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
instructions: Make teriyaki sauce. Grill chicken, basting with sauce.

title: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Sauté garlic in butter. Add shrimp and wine. Toss with pasta.

title: Manty
instructions: Mix lamb filling with onion and pumpkin. Wrap in dough circles. Steam for 40 minutes.

title: BBQ Ribs
instructions: Rub ribs with spices. Bake low and slow. Glaze with BBQ sauce.

title: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Sauté mushrooms. Toast rice. Add broth gradually, stirring. Finish with parmesan.

title: Kung Pao Chicken
instructions: Stir-fry chicken. Add vegetables, peanuts, and sauce.

title: Falafel Plate
instructions: Blend chickpeas with herbs. Form balls and fry. Serve with pita and tahini.

title: Ramen
instructions: Make broth. Cook noodles. Assemble with toppings.

title: Lagman
instructions: Prepare noodles. Stir-fry beef and vegetables. Combine and serve with broth.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs and flour. Fold in chips. Bake at 180°C.

title: Tiramisu
instructions: Make mascarpone cream. Dip ladyfingers in espresso. Layer and refrigerate.

title: Cheesecake
instructions: Make crust. Mix filling. Bake in water bath. Chill overnight.

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Make pie crust. Fill with spiced apples. Cover and bake until golden.

title: Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter. Mix in sugar and eggs. Add flour. Bake.

title: Panna Cotta
instructions: Heat cream with sugar. Add gelatin. Pour into molds. Chill until set.

title: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas. Mix with wet then dry ingredients. Bake until golden.

title: Crème Brûlée
instructions: Make custard. Bake in water bath. Chill. Torch sugar topping before serving.

title: Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Melt chocolate. Fold in whipped cream and beaten egg whites. Chill.

title: Baursak
instructions: Make dough. Let rise. Cut into pieces. Deep fry until golden.

title: Rice Pudding
instructions: Simmer rice in milk with sugar. Cook until creamy. Add vanilla.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Chop all fruits. Toss with honey and lime juice.

title: Lemon Tart
instructions: Make tart shell. Fill with lemon curd. Bake and chill.

title: Mochi
instructions: Cook rice flour with sugar and water. Wrap around ice cream balls.

title: Chak-Chak
instructions: Make dough strips. Fry until golden. Coat with hot honey syrup. Shape into mound.

title: Guacamole
instructions: Mash avocado. Mix in lime juice, onion, tomato, and cilantro.

title: Hummus
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Drizzle with olive oil.

title: Bruschetta
instructions: Toast bread. Top with diced tomatoes, garlic, basil, and oil.

title: Deviled Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs. Halve and remove yolks. Mix yolks with mayo and mustard. Fill whites.

title: Spring Rolls
instructions: Dip rice paper in water. Fill with ingredients and roll tightly.

title: Nachos
instructions: Layer chips with cheese. Bake until melted. Top with jalapeños and sour cream.

title: Samsa
instructions: Make filling with minced lamb and onion. Wrap in triangular pastry. Bake until golden.

title: Mozzarella Sticks
instructions: Coat cheese sticks in flour, egg, breadcrumbs. Freeze. Fry until golden.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems. Fill caps with cheese mixture. Bake until bubbly.

title: Edamame
instructions: Boil edamame. Toss with salt and sesame oil.

title: Chicken Wings
instructions: Bake or fry wings. Toss in hot sauce and butter mixture.

title: Quesadilla
instructions: Fill tortilla with cheese and chicken. Cook on both sides until crispy.

title: Pita Chips
instructions: Cut pita into triangles. Brush with oil and spices. Bake until crisp.

title: Popcorn
instructions: Pop kernels in oil. Toss with melted butter and salt.

title: Caprese Skewers
instructions: Thread tomato, mozzarella, basil on skewers. Drizzle with balsamic.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
instructions: Stir-fry vegetables in hot wok. Add sauce and serve over rice.

title: Pasta Primavera
instructions: Cook pasta. Sauté vegetables. Toss together with olive oil.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Bread and fry chicken. Top with sauce and cheese. Bake until bubbly.

title: Bibimbap
instructions: Arrange rice with sautéed vegetables and beef. Top with fried egg.

title: Tacos al Pastor
instructions: Marinate pork. Grill with pineapple. Serve in tortillas with onion and cilantro.

title: Tom Yum Soup
instructions: Simmer broth with lemongrass and chili. Add shrimp and mushrooms.

title: Cobb Salad
instructions: Arrange rows of ingredients on lettuce. Serve with ranch dressing.

title: French Onion Soup
instructions: Caramelize onions slowly. Add broth. Top with bread and cheese. Broil.

title: Pho
instructions: Simmer broth with spices. Add noodles and thin beef slices. Garnish.

title: Lentil Soup
instructions: Sauté vegetables. Add lentils and broth. Simmer until soft. Blend.

title: Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes. Mix with mayo, mustard, and vegetables. Chill.

title: Fish Tacos
instructions: Grill fish. Serve in tortillas with cabbage slaw and lime crema.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Mix filling. Stuff peppers. Bake with sauce and cheese until done.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Simmer chicken. Add vegetables and noodles. Season and serve.

title: Sushi Rolls
instructions: Spread rice on nori. Add fillings. Roll tightly. Slice.

title: Beef Burgers
instructions: Form patties. Grill to desired doneness. Assemble burgers.

title: Chicken Shawarma
instructions: Marinate chicken. Grill or roast. Serve in pita with garlic sauce.

title: Carbonara
instructions: Cook pasta. Fry pancetta. Toss with egg and cheese mixture off heat.

title: Meatballs
instructions: Mix and roll meatballs. Bake. Simmer in marinara sauce.

title: Beef Stew
instructions: Brown beef. Add vegetables and broth. Simmer until tender.

title: Shelpek
instructions: Make thin dough rounds. Fry in oil until golden and puffy.

title: Blini
instructions: Make thin batter. Cook small pancakes. Serve with sour cream or jam.

title: Eggs Florentine
instructions: Sauté spinach. Poach eggs. Assemble on muffins with hollandaise.

title: Gazpacho
instructions: Blend all vegetables with olive oil and vinegar. Chill and serve cold.

title: Chicken Quesadilla
instructions: Fill tortilla with chicken, cheese, and veggies. Cook both sides until crispy.
